newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine industrial production rose 6.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine industrial production rose 6.6 pct.

text.p: Argentina's industrial production rose 6.6 percent in January compared with the same month a year earlier, the Economy Ministry said Thursday.
Compared with December 1996, industrial production rose 0.6 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis.
In non-seasonally adjusted terms, production fell 6.8 percent in January from December.
The ministry said activity in January has to take into account the holidays in that month.
"A better evaluation of (output levels) will be had next month when figures for the two-month period will be ready," said the ministry.
